findings.rule: 268-c9 with ProfileLimits: the facts the app validates server evidence against must be the facts it sent
findings.trigger: Profile with 3 confirmed USER_ANSWER entries first, then 40 confirmed IMPORTED entries. toFactsDto now sends IMPORTED 1-40, but RemoteJobAnalysisSource.kt:42 and :57 build factIds from profile.confirmedWithinLimits() without the filter (USER_ANSWER 1-3 + IMPORTED 1-37), and RemoteResumeTailor.kt:92 builds sourceText the same way. Server evidence citing IMPORTED 38-40 (or their bullets) is dropped and the requirement falls back to GAP; a tailored bullet sourced from them gets an empty 'was' text; USER_ANSWER ids, never sent, are accepted as evidence. Latent today: no production code creates USER_ANSWER entries yet.
findings.title: USER_ANSWER filter applies only to the sent payload, so evidence and source-text validation use a different fact window
findings.proof: RemoteJobAnalysisSourceTest: the profile above, fake API returns a match citing IMPORTED entry 40 -> assert the match keeps that evidence id (fails today). Fix: move the USER_ANSWER filter into one shared sendable-facts function (or into confirmedWithinLimits) used by toFactsDto, RemoteJobAnalysisSource and RemoteResumeTailor.
